title: S&P 500, Nasdaq, Dow Futures Rise On Hopes Of Hormuz Reopening As Trump Teases ‘Great Deal’ With Iran: BB, INFQ, NVTS, ASTS In Focus
title_zh: 特朗普调侃与伊朗达成“伟大协议”，霍尔木兹海峡重新开放，标普 500 指数、纳斯达克指数和道琼斯指数期货上涨：聚焦 BB、INFQ、NVTS、ASTS
summary: U.S. President Donald Trump said in a post on Truth Social on Monday that negotiations with Iran are proceeding nicely, even as the military conducted “self-defense strikes” on southern Iran.
summary_zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周一在《真相社会》上发帖表示，尽管军方对伊朗南部进行了“自卫袭击”，但与伊朗的谈判进展顺利。

title: Markets rejoice as deal to reopen Hormuz nears, but U.S. forces conduct ‘self-defense strikes’ on Iranian missile sites and boats laying mines
title_zh: 随着重新开放霍尔木兹海峡的协议临近，市场欢欣鼓舞，但美军对伊朗导弹基地和布设水雷的船只进行“自卫袭击”
summary: “U.S. forces conducted self-defense strikes in southern Iran today to protect our troops from threats posed by Iranian forces."
summary_zh: “美军今天在伊朗南部进行了自卫袭击，以保护我们的军队免受伊朗军队的威胁。”

title: Oil Prices Drop on Prospect of Iran Deal, but Investors Aren’t Celebrating Yet
title_zh: 伊朗协议前景导致油价下跌，但投资者尚未庆祝
summary: Brent crude fell roughly 7%, and Dow Jones Industrial Average futures rallied even as investors remain skeptical about the impact of the U.S.-Iran talks.
summary_zh: 尽管投资者仍对美伊谈判的影响持怀疑态度，但布伦特原油下跌约 7%，道琼斯工业平均指数期货上涨。

title: Private Credit Really Is More Than Loans to Leveraged Buyouts
title_zh: 私人信贷实际上不仅仅是杠杆收购贷款
summary: Investors are worried about loans that private-credit funds have made to fund buyouts., but the funds do a lot more than that.
summary_zh: 投资者担心私人信贷基金为收购提供的贷款，但这些基金的作用远不止于此。

title: Dow Jones Futures Rise, Oil Prices Fall: Trump Says No 'Rush' For Iran Deal
title_zh: 道琼斯期货上涨，油价下跌：特朗普称不“急于”达成伊朗协议
summary: President Donald Trump said an interim agreement is close that would open the Strait of Hormuz, but negotiations continue.
summary_zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统表示，开放霍尔木兹海峡的临时协议已接近达成，但谈判仍在继续。
